A '''species''' with large wide [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were covered in [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]], and possessed short beaks, a single antennae, and a tail. They had short [[Limb/Legends|legs]] with two toes on each foot. The [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Navior|"Bullseye" Navior]] was a member of this species, and his nickname of "Bullseye" was actually derived from his large, gaping eyes.

==Behind the scenes==
The species was originally created during the pre-production phase of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], a film that was released during [[1999]]. Detailed concept art was drawn by [[Terryl Whitlatch]], but the character was cut from the film. The design was later reused for the character "Bullseye" Navior in the 1999 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'', which brought the species into canon for the first time.
